questions.scenario: An agent must report the live delivery status of an order held in the company order system.
questions.question: Which capability should you add?

options.text: File search over last year’s PDF reports
options.why: The PDFs would not hold current status.
Fine-tuning does not give live data.
It does not provide data.

options.text: A function tool that calls the order system
options.why: Correct. Live data from a system requires a tool.

questions.explanation: Use function calling for live data and actions.

questions.scenario: Users upload a contract during a conversation and ask questions about it.
questions.question: Which tool fits?

options.why: Correct. It searches files provided to the agent or conversation.
Memory stores learned facts about the user, not document contents.
It checks content for risk.
It runs code and is not intended for searching documents.

questions.explanation: File search handles documents users or apps bring in.

questions.scenario: An agent should remember that a customer prefers WhatsApp updates in conversations that happen weeks apart.
questions.question: What should you use?

options.why: It does not store preferences.

options.text: Memory with a scope per user
options.why: Correct. Memory persists across conversations.

options.text: The conversation of the first session only
options.why: A conversation is not shared automatically with later sessions.

options.text: A higher max output tokens value
options.why: It controls reply length.

questions.explanation: Scope memory per user so one customer never sees another’s facts.

questions.scenario: In function calling, the model returns a request to call get_order_status.
questions.question: Which component runs the function?

options.why: Search does not run application functions.
The portal does not run application code at runtime.

options.text: The application code that owns the function
options.why: Correct. The app executes it and returns the result.
Models do not execute your code.

questions.explanation: The model asks, your code acts, and you send the result back.

questions.scenario: An agent must call a partner REST API that has an OpenAPI specification and must also ground answers on an existing Azure AI Search index.
questions.question: Which two tools should you add? Select two.

options.why: Correct. It grounds the agent on the index.
Speech output is not required.
It is not an agent tool for these needs.
Correct. It calls the API described by the specification.

questions.explanation: Tools can include APIs, search, files, MCP servers and functions.
